mapper.sql: c.CONSULT_NO, c.MEMBER_NO, c.LAWYER_NO, TO_CHAR(c.CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CONSULT_DATE, TO_CHAR(c.CONSULT_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS CONSULT_TIME, c.DURATION, c.MEMO, c.STATUS, c.PAID_YN, c.REVIEWED_YN, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, lm.NAME AS LAWYER_NAME, m.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, m.PHONE AS MEMBER_PHONE, l.CONSULT_FEE
FROM TB_CONSULT c JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_NO = c.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON l.LAWYER_NO = c.LAWYER_NO JOIN TB_MEMBER lm ON lm.MEMBER_NO = l.MEMBER_NO
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CONSULT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_CONSULT (CONSULT_NO, MEMBER_NO, LAWYER_NO, CONSULT_DATE, CONSULT_TIME, DURATION, MEMO, STATUS, PAID_YN, REVIEWED_YN, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{consultNo}, #{memberNo}, #{lawyerNo}, TO_DATE(#{consultDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{consultTime}, 'HH24:MI'), #{duration}, #{memo}, 'PENDING', 'N', 'N', SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(CONSULT_TIME, 'HH24:MI') FROM TB_CONSULT WHERE LAWYER_NO = #{lawyerNo} AND CONSULT_DATE = TO_DATE(#{consultDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CONSULT SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CONSULT_NO = #{consultNo}
UPDATE TB_CONSULT SET PAID_YN = 'Y', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CONSULT_NO = #{consultNo}
UPDATE TB_CONSULT SET REVIEWED_YN = 'Y', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CONSULT_NO = #{consultNo}
